content.name: Kuroni and Impossible Calculation
content.description:
为了成为 Codeforces 的王者，Kuroni 需要解决如下问题。

他得到了 $n$ 个数 $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$。请你帮助 Kuroni 计算 $\prod_{1\le i<j\le n} |a_i - a_j|$。由于结果可能非常大，请输出其对 $m$ 取模的结果。

如果你不熟悉简写符号，$\prod_{1\le i<j\le n} |a_i - a_j|$ 等价于 $|a_1 - a_2|\cdot|a_1 - a_3|\cdot\dots\cdot|a_1 - a_n|\cdot|a_2 - a_3|\cdot|a_2 - a_4|\cdot\dots\cdot|a_2 - a_n|\cdot\dots\cdot|a_{n-1} - a_n|$。换句话说，就是对所有满足 $1\le i < j \le n$ 的 $|a_i - a_j|$ 的乘积。
content.formatI:
第一行包含两个整数 $n$、$m$（$2\le n \le 2\cdot 10^5$，$1\le m \le 1000$）——数字的个数和取模的值。

第二行包含 $n$ 个整数 $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$（$0 \le a_i \le 10^9$）。
content.formatO: 输出一个整数，即 $\prod_{1\le i<j\le n} |a_i - a_j| \bmod m$。
content.hint:
在第一个样例中，$|8 - 5| = 3 \equiv 3 \bmod 10$。

在第二个样例中，$|1 - 4|\cdot|1 - 5|\cdot|4 - 5| = 3\cdot 4 \cdot 1 = 12 \equiv 0 \bmod 12$。

在第三个样例中，$|1 - 4|\cdot|1 - 9|\cdot|4 - 9| = 3 \cdot 8 \cdot 5 = 120 \equiv 1 \bmod 7$。

en.name: Kuroni and Impossible Calculation
en.description:
To become the king of Codeforces, Kuroni has to solve the following problem.

He is given $ n $ numbers $ a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n $ . Help Kuroni to calculate $ \prod_{1\le i<j\le n} |a_i - a_j| $ . As result can be very big, output it modulo $ m $ .

If you are not familiar with short notation, $ \prod_{1\le i<j\le n} |a_i - a_j| $ is equal to $ |a_1 - a_2|\cdot|a_1 - a_3|\cdot $ $ \dots $ $ \cdot|a_1 - a_n|\cdot|a_2 - a_3|\cdot|a_2 - a_4|\cdot $ $ \dots $ $ \cdot|a_2 - a_n| \cdot $ $ \dots $ $ \cdot |a_{n-1} - a_n| $ . In other words, this is the product of $ |a_i - a_j| $ for all $ 1\le i < j \le n $ .
en.formatI:
The first line contains two integers $ n $ , $ m $ ( $ 2\le n \le 2\cdot 10^5 $ , $ 1\le m \le 1000 $ ) — number of numbers and modulo.

The second line contains $ n $ integers $ a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n $ ( $ 0 \le a_i \le 10^9 $ ).
en.formatO: Output the single number — $ \prod_{1\le i<j\le n} |a_i - a_j| \bmod m $ .
en.hint:
In the first sample, $ |8 - 5| = 3 \equiv 3 \bmod 10 $ .

In the second sample, $ |1 - 4|\cdot|1 - 5|\cdot|4 - 5| = 3\cdot 4 \cdot 1 = 12 \equiv 0 \bmod 12 $ .

In the third sample, $ |1 - 4|\cdot|1 - 9|\cdot|4 - 9| = 3 \cdot 8 \cdot 5 = 120 \equiv 1 \bmod 7 $ .
